en: Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view night postcard divided into four panels, showing illuminated Baroque and historic buildings, a decorated bridge railing, and waterfront facades. The scenes focus on a cathedral with a tall tower, ornate palace‑like buildings, and riverfront architecture, all photographed at night. No printed title or visible caption text appears on the image side.
